annotations.title: Connect or renew the FirmLedger account

description: Connect this assistant to the member's own FirmLedger account by sign-in (OAuth), or renew or replace that connection. Call it when the member says "connect me to my account", "sign me in", or asks to switch accounts. The assistant opens FirmLedger in the browser, the member approves there, and no password or key passes through the chat. mode "connect" (the default) starts sign-in when the connection needs it. mode "reauthenticate" ends the current connection so the member can choose the account again. mode "refresh" renews a sign-in token that is about to expire, and the assistant should then retry.
